description:
OPTIONAL POST-RELEASE enhancement; no PR A/B blocker. Correct first release excludes hidden Bcc without independent evidence; never infer from username/folder/Delivered-To. Preserve future discovery/tests, not a required release edge.

## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A (optional follow-up, not a first-release blocker). One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Follow-up to .14.2.2 for hidden Bcc on inbound email. Current IMAP settings expose username and selected folder names, neither independently attests the address that received a message. Determine authoritative account-address evidence available from adapter/server and persist/validate a connector-scoped account identity only when independently established; if unavailable, leave Bcc unassociated and document limitation rather than infer from Delivered-To, folder or header. Any BO UI change must stay under communication-channel settings and read DESIGN.md/docs/bo-components.md first; new-feature E2E authoring waits for human UX approval. Tests first for alias, multi-account ambiguity, mismatched connector and denial of unsupported Bcc. Reuse existing IMAP configuration and IdentityResolver, no new agent Action/tool.
title: [zaq-emb.14.2.5] Establish receiving-account identity evidence
